ValidationRule.description: This validation checks the process status for updating bank details and validates if Contact Email matches
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( CONTAINS($User.Username, 'qcc.recovery.ms@qantas.com.au'), RecordType.DeveloperName = "EFT_Recovery", AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Contact_Validation_Email__c), ISCHANGED(Bank_Account_Number__c) ), UPPER(Contact_Validation_Email__c) <> UPPER(Contact_Email__c) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Update failed: Invalid email or recovery status
